note: Honest capability state for issue #5423 at authoring time. No live behavioral probe was run, so every capability is UNVERIFIED with an explicit reason. Runtime versions are filled live by scripts/eval/eval_harness_capability.py when the CLI is installed and probe-capable. VERIFIED is reserved for backend evidence only. Provider/model/pricing authority stays in scripts/eval/_providers.py and scripts/eval/_eval_common.py; supported_models here is the observed-live set, not a registry.
